paragraphs.text: Several Magic stories have been retold in Japanese Manga style comics .
Magic - Urza & Mishra was published by Gotta Comics in December 2000. It is a retelling of the Brothers' War .
The cover depicts Urza , Ashnod and Mishra . In contrast to other magic media, Mishra is confusingly shown here as blonde, while Urza has black hair.
On February 27, 2010, the Japanese magazine Dengeki-Maoh published The Eternal Blaze , a manga-version of The Purifying Fire , drawn by Yoshino Himori.

Starting with Ixalan block , Wizards of the Coast Japan published a retelling of Magic Story on the MtG-JP Magic Story page. In 2023, all stories published to that point received a paper publication by Kadogawa spread over two volumes, which also included retro frame promos. The manga for Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty was released in both Japanese and English. Theros Beyond Death , which did not receive a book or story articles, did not receive a manga either.

A wizards-licensed romance manga series by an independent publisher, written by Ise Katsura and illustrated by Yokota Takuma (2018-2025). It follows middle schooler protagonists Hajime Kano and Emi Sawatari as they play competitive Magic in the late nineties.
